path.activity: Open an empty personal workspace or deliberately leave sample mode
Create/edit stocks or preview and import a watchlist CSV
Author and publish a versioned recipe with roles, gates, risk and alert/review rules
Bind the recipe to a stock as an Eye and inspect its supported preview
Supply authorized completed daily bars with explicit adjustment basis
Evaluate at explicit time/session through shared engine; preserve UNKNOWN and stale/partial semantics
Run scheduled work with UI closed using SQLite leases/retries/reconciliation/catch-up
path.boundary: Owner installs launchd/cron, uses authorized CSV directory and keeps machine awake; inspect missed/blocked/partial status after interruption.

path.activity: Commit evaluation/alert evidence and separate notification intent
Expose worker changes in Today/Alerts/Journal when owner opens app
Current bridge: import worker full JSON into app, then export app and revision-check worker replacement
path.boundary: Operations validate and recover, but repeated whole-workspace shuttling, schedule pause and revision handling are too cumbersome for the promised monitoring/review loop.

path.activity: Review alert/evidence and record decision, amendment, later outcome/lesson
Export full workspace, retain previous copy and restore at isolated SQLite path
Use email only if explicitly configured; distinguish intent, acceptance, receipt and review

monitoring_scheduler_boundary.catch_up: Later invocation reconciles bounded missed sessions and durable unfinished work; sleep/offline time delays work until wake/invocation.
monitoring_scheduler_boundary.status_projection: Safe versioned worker status includes invocation, expected/successful session, deadlines, missed/partial/blocked/retrying/terminal coverage, queue, ingestion, notification and recovery indicators.
monitoring_scheduler_boundary.owner_setup_dependency: Install and monitor launchd/cron externally; no always-on or hosted availability claim.

worker_to_app_handoff_boundary.worker_output: Complete validated schemaVersion 2 StockLedger JSON backup
worker_to_app_handoff_boundary.current_bridge: Manual full export/import in both directions; existing-worker replacement requires matching --import-revision and creates before-import copy.
worker_to_app_handoff_boundary.consequence: Today is not updated from closed-app worker output until manual import; status is last-known/imported, not live.

attention_delivery_boundary.in_app_today_review: Works for app's currently loaded workspace; external channel not required.
attention_delivery_boundary.notification_intent: Durable intent separate from alert creation and transport.
attention_delivery_boundary.smtp: Optional server-only transport; endpoint and destination are owner input.
attention_delivery_boundary.provider_accepted: Never called delivered; SMTP 250 remains provider-accepted/ambiguous.
attention_delivery_boundary.confirmed_delivery: Only transport-specific confirmed receipt; no human-open claim.
